- It relied on outdated software that was not Y2K compliant and could not produce work orders or the management information needed to improve department efficiency [S1].
- A proliferation of phone numbers for different City programs, plus an area code split that required 10-digit dialing, made it hard for residents to reach services [S1].
- It was also intended to improve communication among departments, reduce response time to residents' requests, and generate management reports [S1].
